title: Renting an Audi RS in a Montreal Winter: The Complete Guide
description: Winter tires, quattro, which model to pick for snow and the Laurentians: everything you need to know to rent an Audi RS in Montreal between December and March.
answer: Yes, you can rent an Audi RS in Montreal in the middle of winter. At RentMyRS, every car (RS3, RS5, RS7, RSQ8) has **quattro** all-wheel drive and runs **winter tires**, which are mandatory in Quebec from December 1 to March 15. Prices stay the same in winter: from $400 per day for the RS3 to $900 for the Stage 2 RS7, with a refundable deposit of $3,000 to $5,000.

sections.h: Why an Audi RS is built for Quebec winters
p: Most sports cars are rear-wheel drive and hibernate from November to April. Every Audi RS comes with **quattro**, Audi’s all-wheel drive system. Torque is split across all four wheels, giving confident traction on snow and downtown slush.
On proper winter tires, an RS stays a performance car you can use every day, even after a storm. That makes it the natural pick for a sports car rental in Montreal in December, January or February.

sections.h: Which Audi RS should you pick when it snows?
list: **[RSQ8](/en/audi-rsq8-rental-montreal)** ($800/day): the most practical in winter, with SUV ground clearance, five seats and a big trunk for skis.
**[RS5 Sportback](/en/audi-rs5-rental-montreal)** ($500/day): five doors, a real trunk and a 444 hp twin-turbo V6, perfect for a road trip to Tremblant.
**[RS3](/en/audi-rs3-rental-montreal)** ($400/day): compact and nimble in the city, with the five-cylinder soundtrack. The best way into the RS world.
**[RS7 Sportback Stage 2](/en/audi-rs7-rental-montreal)** ($900/day): the most powerful, best left to experienced drivers when roads are slippery.

sections.h: The rules to know in Quebec
p: In Quebec, winter tires are mandatory on passenger vehicles from December 1 to March 15. Every RS we rent is fitted accordingly during the cold season, so there is nothing for you to arrange.

To rent, you must be 25 or older, with a valid driver’s licence, proof of insurance and a credit card in your name for the refundable security deposit. No online payment: send a request and the team confirms by text.

sections.h: Winter drives to do in an Audi RS
list: Head up to **Saint-Sauveur** or **Mont-Tremblant** on Highway 15 for a ski day.
An evening in **Old Montreal** lit up for the holidays.
A weekend in the **Eastern Townships** (Bromont, Magog) in the RS5 or RSQ8.
A snowy photo run on the **North Shore**: we deliver to Laval, Terrebonne, Blainville and Mirabel. See [North Shore delivery](/en/audi-rs-rental-north-shore-montreal).

sections.h: How booking works, step by step
p: Pick your RS and your dates on the site, or send us a text or WhatsApp at 514 773-8079. There is no online payment and nothing is charged when you send the request.

The team checks availability, then texts you to confirm your licence, insurance and the refundable deposit. Once everything is in order, you either pick up the car in Montreal or we deliver it to your home, hotel or office, including Laval, the North Shore, the South Shore and YUL airport.
Book a few days ahead for the holidays and ski weekends: these are the busiest periods of the winter, and the RSQ8 is usually the first car to go.

sections.h: Driving tips to enjoy your RS in winter
p: Give the engine a few minutes to warm up before using the full power. Keep comfort or auto drive modes on snow, and leave longer braking distances: quattro helps you accelerate, not stop shorter.
Finally, clear all the snow off the car (roof included) before leaving: it is required in Quebec and safer for everyone.

faq: Are rental prices higher in winter?
No. Rates stay the same all year: RS3 $400, RS5 $500, RSQ8 $800 and RS7 $900 per day, before taxes and delivery.
Do the Audi RS cars have winter tires?
Yes, every RS runs winter tires during the cold season, as Quebec law requires from December 1 to March 15.
Which Audi RS is best for a ski trip?
The RSQ8, thanks to its ground clearance, five seats and big trunk. The RS5 Sportback is a good alternative for two to four people.
Do you deliver the car in winter?
Yes, on request across Montreal, Laval, the North Shore, the South Shore and YUL airport. Fees are confirmed with the booking.
